When both fail it returns false, and discardJob restores the original ready result with DISCARD_FAILED instead of claiming completed discard. A later explicit retry uses the same operation/result.
closedFinding.test: D15 blocks the local reservation write and server ack together, asserts ready is temporarily unavailable, attempts apply and run with zero commit/new provider call, then requires the original ready result plus explicit error and unchanged server ack. After writes/network recover it retries discard and verifies terminal ack with no saved reading. This directly covers the previously missing dual-failure boundary.
closedFinding.complementaryEvidence: The earlier D14 already covers locally persisted discard intent through server-ack failure and reload. D15 addresses the different case where the local durable intent cannot be written; it correctly reports failure and leaves recovery possible rather than pretending persistence can succeed. No execution was repeated here.
